paras: Lampropholis caligula, also known commonly as the montane sunskink or the montane sun skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to New South Wales in Australia.
The specific name, caligula, refers to the Roman emperor, Caligula.
The preferred natural habitats of L. caligula are forest, shrubland, and freshwater wetlands.
